members.name: correlation_breakdown_arb_v1
members.universe: RELIANCE vs ONGC on NSE (energy sector pair with 0.65+ daily correlation)
members.thesis: Highly correlated NIFTY 50 stocks (rolling 20-day correlation > 0.8) occasionally experience intraday correlation breakdowns where one stock moves sharply while its correlated peer stays flat. These breakdowns are typically caused by single large block trades, mutual fund rebalancing, or news misatt
entry_long: spread_z < -1.5 (RELIANCE underperforming, buy RELIANCE sell ONGC)
entry_short: spread_z > 1.5 (RELIANCE outperforming, sell RELIANCE buy ONGC)
members.exit_target: corr_30 recovers to within 0.1 of corr_baseline OR spread_z crosses 0
members.exit_stop: spread_z exceeds 3.0 OR loss > 0.5% OR corr_30 drops below 0 (anti-correlated)
filters: India_VIX < 25; high VIX causes legitimate correlation breakdowns
both legs 1-min volume > 10000 shares at entry
weaknesses: RELIANCE is a diversified conglomerate (oil, retail, telecom) while ONGC is pure-play upstream oil; genuine business divergences are common and the correlation baseline may be overstated
The 30-bar rolling correlation window is noisy with 1-min data; random price fluctuations can trigger false correlation breakdown signals
Low signal frequency (1-2 trades/day at best) means the strategy is capital-inefficient and may need to be combined with other strategies to justify monitoring infrastructure
members.prior_art: Cont & Bouchaud (2000) correlation dynamics; Lillo & Mantegna (2005) correlation-based trading. Adapted for intraday Indian energy sector pair with crude oil filter.

members.name: correlation_regime_v1
members.thesis: Individual stocks' correlation with their parent index (NIFTY 50 or Bank NIFTY) varies intraday. When a stock's rolling 30-bar correlation with the index drops below 0.3 (decoupled), the stock is driven by idiosyncratic factors — if these are positive (stock up, index flat), the move tends to persis
entry_long: Alpha_30 > 20 bps (stock generating positive alpha while decoupled)
NIFTY_Flat == True (index is flat — confirming idiosyncratic move)
entry_short: Alpha_30 < -20 bps (stock generating negative alpha while decoupled)
filters: India VIX < 22 (high VIX = high correlation = fewer decoupled opportunities)
No entries before 09:45 (need 30 bars for correlation) or after 15:10
Stock volume > SMA(volume, 20) during decoupled period
NIFTY_Flat must be True (abs NIFTY 30-bar return < 15 bps)
weaknesses: Correlation computed on 30 1-min returns has very wide confidence intervals — at 30 observations, a measured correlation of 0.30 has a 95% CI of roughly [0.0, 0.55], making the threshold unreliable

NIFTY_Flat requirement (abs return < 15 bps over 30 bars) is very restrictive — during active market hours, NIFTY rarely stays within 15 bps for 30 minutes, limiting opportunities to low-volume periods
Decoupling often occurs during news/events specific to the stock — these are precisely the situations where the stock may gap further in either direction, making the 25 bps stop inadequate
